shared.shell.sandbox.body.message: エージェントはコマンドを独自のサンドボックス内で実行しており、このコマンドはそのサンドボックスによって停止されました。Kage で承認してもこれは変わりませんが、サンドボックスの外でご自身で実行することはできます。まずコマンド全体を読み、すべてを信頼できる場合にのみ実行してください。
shared.shell.sandbox.body.description: Explanation in the notice under a shell command that the AI agent's own security sandbox blocked. Kage's tool approvals only decide whether Kage asks before the agent runs something; they can't lift the agent's sandbox, so the user may run the command themselves (Kage can run it for them, outside the sandbox, after a confirm; or they copy it into a terminal). The notice can't vouch for the command (a command can print a sandbox error itself), so the user is asked to read all of it first; the full command is shown right below this text.

'Terminal' is the terminal app.

settings.manager.ext.agent.outcome.timeo.description: Outcome of a background request: the agent didn't finish in time

settings.manager.ext.agent.outcome.cance.message: キャンセルされました
settings.manager.ext.agent.outcome.cance.description: Outcome of a background request: cancelled

settings.manager.ext.agent.outcome.tool_.message: 停止：エージェントがツールを使用しようとしました
settings.manager.ext.agent.outcome.tool_.description: Outcome of a background request: the agent started a tool, so Kage stopped it

settings.manager.ext.agent.outcome.agent.description: Outcome of a background request: the agent reported an error

settings.manager.ext.agent.outcome.conne.message: エージェントとの接続が切断されました
settings.manager.ext.agent.outcome.conne.description: Outcome of a background request: the agent connection dropped

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.title.message: {extension} がバックグラウンドで {agent} を使用することを許可しますか？
settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.title.description: Title of the Background AI consent dialog. {agent} is the agent connection's name.

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.where.message: {agent} は受け取った内容をオンラインサービスに送信します。
settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.where.description: Consent dialog: the agent is a known cloud service

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.where.message: {agent} はこのコンピューター上で動作します。
settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.where.description: Consent dialog: the agent is a local model on this computer

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.where.message: {agent} は別のコンピューター（{host}）上で動作します。
settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.where.description: Consent dialog: the agent runs on another computer. {host} is its host name or address.

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.where.message: {agent} が受け取った内容をどこに送信するか、Kage では判別できません。オンラインサービスである可能性があります。
settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.where.description: Consent dialog: Kage doesn't know where the agent sends text

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.reaso.description: Consent dialog: the extension's own explanation, quoted. {reason} is the extension's text, shown as is.

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.what.message: 送信する内容は {extension} が選択します。{extension} は自身のデータからテキストを送信でき、リクエストは 1 日 {calls} 件までです。
settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.what.description: Consent dialog bullet. {calls} is a number.

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.reads.message: {extension} は次のデータも読み取れます：{capabilities}。
settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.reads.description: Consent dialog bullet, shown only when the extension holds data permissions. {capabilities} is a list of permission names.

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.when.message: リクエストは Kage を使用していない間に実行されます。チャットを開始すると停止します。

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.tools.message: Kage はエージェントにツールを使用しないよう求め、すべてのツールリクエストを拒否します。エージェントが確認なしでツールを実行する設定になっている場合、Kage はツールの実行開始を検知した時点でリクエストを停止します。

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.histo.message: リクエストはチャットに表示されません。エージェントは、すべての会話と同様に独自の記録を保持する場合があります。

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.log.message: すべてのリクエストは、このページと「設定 → ツールの権限」に一覧表示されます。

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.allow.description: Consent dialog button that turns background AI on

settings.manager.ext.agent.consent.cance.description: Consent dialog button that leaves background AI off

settings.manager.ext.views.heading.description: Heading of the block on an extension's settings page that lists the windows the extension draws itself

settings.manager.ext.views.open.description: Button: open one of the extension's own windows

settings.manager.ext.views.reset.message: ウィンドウのサイズと位置をリセット
settings.manager.ext.views.reset.description: Button: forget the saved size and position of the extension's windows

settings.manager.ext.views.reset_done.message: ウィンドウのサイズと位置をリセットしました。
settings.manager.ext.views.reset_done.description: Confirmation after resetting the extension windows' size and position

settings.manager.ext.sync.settings_and_d.description: Chip in an extension's settings header: its settings and its data sync between the user's computers.

settings.manager.ext.sync.settings_only.description: Chip in an extension's settings header: only its settings sync between the user's computers.

settings.manager.ext.sync.sign_in_local.message: サインイン情報はこのコンピューターにのみ保存
settings.manager.ext.sync.sign_in_local.description: Chip in an extension's settings header: its sign-in or API key never syncs.

floating.agent_call.chip.message: {extension} がエージェントを使用中
floating.agent_call.chip.description: Small chip in the launcher while an extension's background AI request runs. The moon icon is separate.

floating.agent_call.waiting.description: Added to the background AI chip when more requests wait. {n} is a number.

floating.agent_call.stop.description: Button on the background AI chip that stops the requests

floating.agent_call.settings.description: Button on the background AI chip that opens the extension's settings

errors.agent_call.not_available.message: {extension} はバックグラウンド AI を使用できません。バックグラウンド AI の権限がないか、マニフェストで宣言されていません。
errors.agent_call.not_available.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The extension lacks the permission or its manifest has no valid agentBackground block. {extension} is the extension's name.

errors.agent_call.access_off.message: {extension} のバックグラウンド AI はオフになっています。設定 → 拡張機能 → {extension} でオンにしてください。
errors.agent_call.access_off.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The user hasn't turned background AI on for this extension on this computer.

errors.agent_call.consent_required.message: {extension} がエージェントにテキストを送信するには、あなたの許可が必要です。
errors.agent_call.consent_required.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Background AI is switched on, but the user hasn't confirmed the consent dialog.

errors.agent_call.consent_stale.message: エージェントが変更されました。設定で {extension} を再度許可してください。
errors.agent_call.consent_stale.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The active agent connection changed since the user gave consent, so the consent no longer applies.

errors.agent_call.extension_disabled.message: {extension} はオフになっています。
errors.agent_call.extension_disabled.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The extension is disabled, so it can't make requests.

errors.agent_call.agent_changed.message: この画面を開いている間にエージェントが変更されました。エージェント名を確認して、もう一度お試しください。
errors.agent_call.agent_changed.description: Consent dialog: the active agent connection changed while the dialog was open, so the user must confirm again.

errors.agent_call.purpose_not_declared.message: {extension} は目的「{purpose}」を宣言していません。
errors.agent_call.purpose_not_declared.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Developer-facing: the request named a purpose the manifest's agentBackground.purposes doesn't list. {purpose} is the id.

errors.agent_call.field_too_long.message: 「{field}」は {size} 文字です。上限は {limit} 文字です。
errors.agent_call.field_too_long.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Developer-facing: one field of the request is too long. {field} is the field name; {size} and {limit} are numbers.

errors.agent_call.prompt_too_large.message: リクエストは {size} 文字です。上限は {limit} 文字です。
errors.agent_call.prompt_too_large.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The whole prompt Kage would send is over the size limit. {size} and {limit} are numbers.

errors.agent_call.schema_unsupported.message: レスポンススキーマに Kage がサポートしていない要素が含まれています: {keyword}
errors.agent_call.schema_unsupported.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Developer-facing: the JSON schema uses a keyword outside the supported subset. {keyword} is the keyword.

errors.agent_call.contains_credential.message: リクエストに {extension} の保存済み認証情報が含まれているため、Kage は送信しませんでした。
errors.agent_call.contains_credential.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The request text contains a password or key from the extension's own settings, so nothing was sent.

errors.agent_call.duplicate.message: このキーのバックグラウンドリクエストはすでに待機中です。
errors.agent_call.duplicate.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Another request with the same de-duplication key is already queued.

errors.agent_call.queue_full.message: {extension} にはすでに {limit} 件のバックグラウンドリクエストが待機中です。
errors.agent_call.queue_full.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The extension's queue of waiting requests is full. {limit} is a number.

errors.agent_call.rate_limited.message: バックグラウンドリクエストが多すぎます。{time} 以降にもう一度お試しください。
errors.agent_call.rate_limited.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Too many requests in a short time. {time} is a local time of day.

errors.agent_call.budget_exhausted.message: {extension} は本日のバックグラウンド AI の利用枠を使い切りました。{time} にリセットされます。
errors.agent_call.budget_exhausted.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The extension used its daily allowance on this computer. {time} is a local time.

errors.agent_call.paused.message: {extension} のバックグラウンド AI は {time} まで一時停止しています。
errors.agent_call.paused.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Requests are paused (after failures, tool attempts, or the user pressing Stop). {time} is a local time.

errors.agent_call.agent_unavailable.message: エージェントが接続されていません。
errors.agent_call.agent_unavailable.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). No agent is connected. Kage never starts the agent for a background request.

errors.agent_call.agent_disconnected.message: 完了する前にエージェントの接続が切断されました。
errors.agent_call.agent_disconnected.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The agent connection dropped while a request was running.

errors.agent_call.timeout.message: エージェントが {seconds} 秒以内に完了しませんでした。
errors.agent_call.timeout.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The request ran out of time. {seconds} is a number.

errors.agent_call.turn_expired.message: 順番が来てから {seconds} 秒以内にリクエストが送信されなかったため、順番が破棄されました。
errors.agent_call.turn_expired.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Developer-facing: the extension took too long to send its request after Kage gave it a turn. {seconds} is a number.

errors.agent_call.cancelled_by_extension.message: 拡張機能がリクエストをキャンセルしました。
errors.agent_call.cancelled_by_extension.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The extension itself cancelled its request.

errors.agent_call.cancelled_by_user.message: リクエストを停止しました。
errors.agent_call.cancelled_by_user.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The user pressed Stop now.

errors.agent_call.cancelled_user_activit.message: Kage の使用を開始したため停止しました。
errors.agent_call.cancelled_user_activit.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The user started a chat prompt, which stops background requests.

errors.agent_call.cancelled_shutdown.message: Kage が終了するため停止しました。
errors.agent_call.cancelled_shutdown.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Kage is shutting down.

errors.agent_call.cancelled_access_off.message: {extension} のバックグラウンド AI がオフになったため、停止しました。
errors.agent_call.cancelled_access_off.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The user turned background AI off, or disabled or removed the extension, while a request was waiting or running.

errors.agent_call.tool_attempted.message: エージェントがツールを使用しようとしたため、Kage はリクエストを停止しました。
errors.agent_call.tool_attempted.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Background requests may not use tools; the agent started one, so Kage stopped the request.

errors.agent_call.response_too_large.message: エージェントの返信が {limit} 文字を超えたため、Kage は停止しました。
errors.agent_call.response_too_large.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The agent's reply was too long. {limit} is a number.

errors.agent_call.not_json.message: エージェントの返信が JSON ではありませんでした。
errors.agent_call.not_json.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The extension asked for a JSON reply, and the reply had none.

errors.agent_call.invalid_response.message: エージェントの返信が {path} で想定された形式と一致しませんでした。
errors.agent_call.invalid_response.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The JSON reply didn't match the extension's schema. {path} is a JSON path such as $.items[3].text; keep it verbatim.

errors.agent_call.agent_error.message: エージェントがエラーを返しました: {reason}
errors.agent_call.agent_error.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). The agent reported an error. {reason} is the agent's own text, not translated.

errors.agent_call.unknown_call.message: 不明なバックグラウンドリクエスト、または終了済みのリクエストです。
errors.agent_call.unknown_call.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Developer-facing: the request id is unknown, belongs to another extension, or already finished.

errors.agent_call.not_ready.message: このリクエストの順番はまだ来ていません。
errors.agent_call.not_ready.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Developer-facing: the extension tried to send before Kage gave the request its turn.

errors.file_text.not_granted.message: {extension} には、選択したファイルを読み取る権限がありません。
errors.file_text.not_granted.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The extension lacks the Files you choose permission. {extension} is the extension's name.

errors.file_text.extension_disabled.message: {extension} はオフになっています。
errors.file_text.extension_disabled.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The extension is disabled, so it can't ask for a file. {extension} is the extension's name.

errors.file_text.invalid_formats.message: 不明なファイル形式が要求されました。Kage が読み取れる形式: {formats}。
errors.file_text.invalid_formats.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. Developer-facing: the extension asked for a format Kage doesn't know. {formats} is a list of file extensions such as .txt, .md, .pdf; keep it verbatim.

errors.file_text.invalid_max_chars.message: 文字数の上限は 1～{max} の範囲で指定してください。
errors.file_text.invalid_max_chars.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. Developer-facing: the extension asked for a character limit out of range. {max} is a number.

errors.file_text.busy.message: Kage は別のファイルを読み取り中です。完了してから再度お試しください。
errors.file_text.busy.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. Only one file can be read at a time, or the ask bar is already showing.

errors.file_text.too_soon.message: 少し待ってから別のファイルを選択してください。
errors.file_text.too_soon.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The extension asked for another file within a few seconds of the last dialog.

errors.file_text.declined.message: 「後で」が選択されました。しばらくしてから再度お試しください。
errors.file_text.declined.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The user clicked Not now on the ask bar, and the extension asked again too soon. "Not now" is the button label (file_text.ask.dismiss).

errors.file_text.no_window.message: ファイルを選択するには Kage を開いてください。
errors.file_text.no_window.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The window that would show the ask bar is hidden, so Kage didn't ask.

errors.file_text.unavailable.message: この Kage ではファイルの読み取りを利用できません。
errors.file_text.unavailable.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The file reader that ships with Kage is missing from the install.

errors.file_text.dialog_failed.message: ファイル選択ダイアログを開けませんでした。
errors.file_text.dialog_failed.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The system's file dialog failed to open.

errors.file_text.not_a_file.message: {name} は通常のファイルではありません。
errors.file_text.not_a_file.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The user picked a folder, a package or a device. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.unsupported.message: ここでは .{ext} ファイルを読み取れません。読み取れる形式: {formats}。
errors.file_text.unsupported.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The picked file's type isn't one the extension asked for. {ext} is the file's extension without the dot; {formats} is a list of file extensions such as .txt, .md, .pdf. Keep both verbatim.

errors.file_text.wrong_content.message: {name} の内容が拡張子 .{ext} と一致しません。
errors.file_text.wrong_content.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The file's contents don't match its extension (for example a renamed file). {name} is the file name; {ext} is its extension without the dot.

errors.file_text.too_large.message: {name} のサイズは {size} です。Kage が読み取れるのは {limit} までのファイルです。
errors.file_text.too_large.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The file is over the size limit. {name} is the file name; {size} and {limit} are sizes such as 48.2 MB.

errors.file_text.read_failed.message: {name} を読み取れませんでした。
errors.file_text.read_failed.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The operating system refused or failed the read. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.not_downloaded.message: {name} のダウンロードが完了していません。このコンピュータに保存されてから再度お試しください。
errors.file_text.not_downloaded.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The file lives on a cloud drive and didn't download in time. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.encrypted.message: {name} はパスワードで保護されています。パスワードを解除してから再度お試しください。
errors.file_text.encrypted.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The document needs a password to open. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.legacy_format.message: {name} は Kage が読み取れない古い形式です。.docx または PDF として保存してから、もう一度お試しください。
errors.file_text.legacy_format.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. An old binary Office file (such as .doc) saved with a new extension. {name} is the file name; keep .docx and PDF verbatim.

errors.file_text.not_text.message: {name} はテキストファイルではないようです。
errors.file_text.not_text.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. A file named as text holds binary data. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.malformed.message: {name} は破損しているようで、読み取れませんでした。
errors.file_text.malformed.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The document is broken or not what it claims to be. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.too_complex.message: {name} は複雑すぎるため、安全に読み取れません。
errors.file_text.too_complex.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The document went over a safety limit (size, nesting or memory). {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.timeout.message: {name} の読み取りに時間がかかりすぎたため、Kage は処理を停止しました。
errors.file_text.timeout.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. Extracting the text went over the time limit. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.cancelled.message: {name} の読み取りはキャンセルされました。
errors.file_text.cancelled.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. The user or the extension cancelled the read. {name} is the file name.

errors.file_text.worker_failed.message: ファイル読み取りプロセスが予期せず停止しました。
errors.file_text.worker_failed.description: Reading a file the user picked for an extension. Kage's separate file reader process failed or returned something it couldn't use.

errors.ext_view.opener_refused.message: このウインドウからは拡張機能のウインドウを開けません。
errors.ext_view.opener_refused.description: Opening an extension's own window from a Kage window that isn't allowed to (for example the Store).

errors.ext_view.unknown_extension.message: {id} という拡張機能はインストールされていません。
errors.ext_view.unknown_extension.description: Opening an extension window for an extension that isn't installed. {id} is the extension's id.

errors.ext_view.disabled.message: {extension} はオフになっています。
errors.ext_view.disabled.description: Opening an extension window for an extension the user turned off. {extension} is the extension's name.

errors.ext_view.not_granted.message: {extension} が独自のウインドウを開くには、あなたの承認が必要です。
errors.ext_view.not_granted.description: Opening an extension window without the Its own windows permission. {extension} is the extension's name.

errors.ext_view.unknown_view.message: {extension} には {view} というウインドウはありません。
errors.ext_view.unknown_view.description: The extension doesn't declare the window it asked to open. {extension} is the extension's name; {view} is the window's id.

errors.ext_view.wrong_extension.message: 拡張機能のウインドウからは、同じ拡張機能のウインドウしか開けません。
errors.ext_view.wrong_extension.description: An extension window tried to open another extension's window.

errors.ext_view.params_invalid.message: ウインドウの開始データが無効です：{reason}
errors.ext_view.params_invalid.description: The data an extension passes to a window it opens is malformed. {reason} is a short technical reason in English.

errors.ext_view.params_too_large.message: ウインドウの開始データが大きすぎます（{size} バイト、上限は {limit}）。
errors.ext_view.params_too_large.description: The data an extension passes to a window it opens is too large. {size} and {limit} are numbers of bytes.

errors.ext_view.too_many_open.message: 開いている拡張機能のウインドウが多すぎます（上限 {limit}）。いずれかを閉じてから、もう一度お試しください。
errors.ext_view.too_many_open.description: Every allowed extension window is already open and visible. {limit} is a number.

errors.ext_view.not_a_view_window.message: これは拡張機能のウインドウではありません。
errors.ext_view.not_a_view_window.description: A command for extension windows was called from another Kage window.

errors.ext_view.not_focused.message: 拡張機能のウインドウが最前面にありません。
errors.ext_view.not_focused.description: An extension window tried to copy or send text while another window had focus.

errors.ext_view.text_invalid.message: このテキストは使用できません：{reason}
errors.ext_view.text_invalid.description: Text from an extension window is too long or isn't plain text. {reason} is a short technical reason in English.

errors.ext_view.too_fast.message: リクエストが多すぎます。しばらくしてからもう一度お試しください。
errors.ext_view.too_fast.description: An extension window copied or sent text too often in a short time.

errors.ext_view.clipboard_failed.message: クリップボードにコピーできませんでした。
errors.ext_view.clipboard_failed.description: Copying text from an extension window to the system clipboard failed.

errors.ext_view.geometry_write_failed.message: ウインドウの位置を保存できませんでした：{reason}
errors.ext_view.geometry_write_failed.description: Saving or resetting the size and position of extension windows failed. {reason} is a system error message.

file_text.dialog.title.description: Title of the system file dialog an extension opens. {extension} is the extension's name. On macOS it shows as the dialog's message line.

file_text.dialog.filter.description: File type filter in the system file dialog: the file types Kage can read

file_text.ask.message.message: {extension} が、あなたが選択するファイルの読み取りを求めています。

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.long.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. Shown under the command box when the command is too long to fit in it, so the user scrolls to read the rest. {lines} is the number of lines in the command.

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.cancel.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. Button that closes the confirm without running anything.

shared.shell.sandbox.confirm.run.description: In the confirm that opens inside that notice before Kage runs the blocked command for the user, outside the agent's sandbox. Button that runs the command, outside the agent's sandbox.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.sudo.message: sudo を使用しています。ターミナルでパスワードの入力を求められ、コマンドは管理者として実行されます。
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.sudo.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. For a command using sudo (run as administrator), when it will run in the Terminal app.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.sudo_here.message: このコマンドは sudo を使用するためパスワードが必要ですが、ここには入力できるターミナルがありません。代わりにターミナルで実行してください。
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.sudo_here.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. For a command using sudo when the user chose to run it inside Kage, which can't ask for a password; the confirm offers Run in Terminal instead of Run.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.sudo_here_copy.message: このコマンドは sudo を使用するためパスワードが必要ですが、ここには入力できるターミナルがありません。代わりにターミナルにコピーして実行してください。
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.sudo_here_copy.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. Same as the sudo warning, on systems where Kage can't run it in a terminal app; the confirm offers Copy & open Terminal instead of Run.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.rm_rf.message: このコマンドは確認なしでファイルやフォルダを再帰的に削除します（rm -rf）。含まれるすべてのパスを確認してください。
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.rm_rf.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. For a command that deletes recursively and forcibly. 'rm -rf' is the literal command; don't translate it.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.pipe_to_shell.message: このコマンドはスクリプトをダウンロードしてすぐに実行します。入手元が信頼できる場合のみ実行してください。
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.pipe_to_shell.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. For a command like 'curl … | sh' that downloads code from the internet and executes it immediately.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.recursive_root.message: このコマンドは最上位フォルダまたはホームフォルダ以下のすべての権限や所有者を変更します（chmod/chown -R）。システムが壊れたり、ファイルにアクセスできなくなったりするおそれがあります。
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.recursive_root.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. For chmod/chown -R on / , a top-level folder or the home folder. 'chmod/chown -R' is literal; don't translate it.

shared.shell.sandbox.risk.shell_rc.message: このコマンドはシェルの起動ファイル（~/.zshrc など）を変更します。今後開くすべてのターミナルに影響します。
shared.shell.sandbox.risk.shell_rc.description: Caution line in the run confirm, shown because the command matches a risky pattern. 'It' is the command. For a command that writes to a shell configuration file. '~/.zshrc' is a file name; don't translate it.

shared.shell.sandbox.terminal.opening.message: ターミナルを開いています…
shared.shell.sandbox.terminal.opening.description: Part of the notice under a shell command the AI agent's own security sandbox refused. Status while Kage hands the command to the macOS Terminal app.

shared.shell.sandbox.terminal.sent.message: ターミナルで実行中です。
shared.shell.sandbox.terminal.sent.description: Part of the notice under a shell command the AI agent's own security sandbox refused. Status once the macOS Terminal app took the command. Kage doesn't see its output.

shared.shell.sandbox.terminal.failed.message: ターミナルで実行できませんでした：{error}
shared.shell.sandbox.terminal.failed.description: Part of the notice under a shell command the AI agent's own security sandbox refused. Status when handing the command to the Terminal app failed. {error} says why.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.running.message: サンドボックス外で実行中…
shared.shell.sandbox.run.running.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). While it runs.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.stopping.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). After the user pressed Stop, until it has ended.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.stop.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). Button that ends the running command.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.succeeded.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). It finished successfully. 'exit code 0' is the program's result code.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.exit_code.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). It finished with an error. {code} is the program's numeric exit code.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.signal.message: シグナル {signal} により終了
shared.shell.sandbox.run.signal.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). The program was killed by an operating-system signal. {signal} is its number.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.unknown.message: 完了（終了ステータス不明）
shared.shell.sandbox.run.unknown.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). It finished but its result code isn't known.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.cancelled.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). The user pressed Stop and it was ended.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.timed_out.message: {minutes} 分経過したため停止しました（制限時間）
shared.shell.sandbox.run.timed_out.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). It ran too long and Kage ended it. {minutes} is the limit in minutes.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.failed.message: 実行できませんでした：{error}
shared.shell.sandbox.run.failed.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). It didn't start. {error} says why.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.earlier_output.message: … これより前の出力は表示されていません …
shared.shell.sandbox.run.earlier_output.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). Marker at the top of the output view when only its end is shown.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.no_output_yet.message: まだ出力はありません
shared.shell.sandbox.run.no_output_yet.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). Placeholder in the output view while the command runs and hasn't printed anything.

shared.shell.sandbox.run.no_output.message: 出力はありませんでした
shared.shell.sandbox.run.no_output.description: Status of a command the user chose to run themselves from that notice (Kage runs it outside the agent's sandbox and shows its output). Placeholder in the output view when the finished command printed no output.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.sending.message: エージェントに伝えています…
shared.shell.sandbox.agent.sending.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. Shown while that message is being sent.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.queued.message: エージェントは応答中です。応答が終わったら、Kage が結果を伝えます。
shared.shell.sandbox.agent.queued.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. Shown while the agent is still answering, so the message waits.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.dont_tell.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. Button that drops the waiting message, so the agent isn't told.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.sent.message: エージェントに結果を伝えました。
shared.shell.sandbox.agent.sent.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. The message was sent.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.failed.message: エージェントに伝えられませんでした: {error}
shared.shell.sandbox.agent.failed.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. Sending the message failed. {error} says why.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.not_told.message: エージェントには伝えていません。
shared.shell.sandbox.agent.not_told.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. The user chose not to send it (or dropped it).

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.stopped_not_t.message: 停止したため、エージェントには伝えていません。
shared.shell.sandbox.agent.stopped_not_t.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. After the user pressed Stop, Kage doesn't send the result on its own.

shared.shell.sandbox.agent.tell.message: エージェントに伝える
shared.shell.sandbox.agent.tell.description: After the user ran a blocked command themselves, Kage can send the result to the AI agent as the user's next message. Button that sends the result to the agent now.

errors.user_shell.not_allowed.message: コマンドは Kage のチャットウインドウとランチャーウインドウからのみ実行できます。
errors.user_shell.not_allowed.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. The request came from a window that isn't allowed to run commands.

errors.user_shell.empty_command.message: 実行するコマンドがありません。
errors.user_shell.empty_command.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox.

errors.user_shell.command_too_long.message: コマンドが長すぎるため、ここでは実行できません（{max_kib} KB 超）。
errors.user_shell.command_too_long.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. {max_kib} is the size limit in kilobytes.

errors.user_shell.invalid_command.message: コマンドに NUL 文字が含まれているため、実行できません。
errors.user_shell.invalid_command.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. NUL is the zero character, which no command line can contain.

errors.user_shell.invalid_run_id.message: その実行を識別できません。
errors.user_shell.invalid_run_id.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. Internal: the window sent a malformed id for the run.

errors.user_shell.no_home.message: ホームフォルダが見つかりませんでした。
errors.user_shell.no_home.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox.

errors.user_shell.cwd_not_absolute.message: 作業ディレクトリがフルパスではありません: {path}
errors.user_shell.cwd_not_absolute.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. {path} is the folder the agent's command ran in.

errors.user_shell.cwd_missing.message: 作業ディレクトリが存在しません: {path}
errors.user_shell.cwd_missing.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. {path} is the folder the agent's command ran in.

errors.user_shell.cwd_not_directory.message: 作業ディレクトリがフォルダではありません: {path}
errors.user_shell.cwd_not_directory.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. {path} is the path the agent's command ran in.

errors.user_shell.busy.message: このウインドウでは別のコマンドがすでに実行中です。
errors.user_shell.busy.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. Only one runs at a time per window.

errors.user_shell.spawn_failed.message: コマンドを開始できませんでした: {error}
errors.user_shell.spawn_failed.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. {error} is the operating system's error message.

errors.user_shell.terminal_unsupported.message: このシステムではターミナルでのコマンド実行に対応していません。代わりにコピーしてください。
errors.user_shell.terminal_unsupported.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. Run in Terminal is macOS only.

errors.user_shell.terminal_control_chars.message: このコマンドにはタブなどの制御文字が含まれており、ターミナルがキー入力として解釈してしまいます。代わりにコピーしてください。
errors.user_shell.terminal_control_chars.description: Error from Run in Terminal, for a command the user chose to run themselves outside the AI agent's sandbox. Terminal types the command into the shell as if it were typed on the keyboard, so a tab would trigger completion; such a command is only copied.

errors.user_shell.terminal_not_authorize.message: macOS により、Kage によるターミナルの操作が許可されませんでした。「システム設定」→「プライバシーとセキュリティ」→「オートメーション」で許可するか、代わりにコマンドをコピーしてください。
errors.user_shell.terminal_not_authorize.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. macOS refused Kage's request to control the Terminal app. Keep the System Settings path as macOS names it.

errors.user_shell.terminal_failed.message: ターミナルで実行されませんでした: {error}
errors.user_shell.terminal_failed.description: Error from running a command the user chose to run themselves, outside the AI agent's sandbox. {error} is the error macOS reported.

errors.agent_call.field_invalid.description: A background AI request (an extension asking the user's agent for help with no chat). Developer-facing: one field of the request has characters or a shape Kage doesn't accept. {field} is the field name.

errors.ext_view.needs_user_action.message: 先にウィンドウ内をクリックするか、キーを押してください。
errors.ext_view.needs_user_action.description: An extension window tried to open a window, copy text or send text to the launcher without a recent click or key press from the user.

ext_view.state.approve.description: Button in an extension's own window when the extension needs the user's approval to open it. Opens the Store, where the user reviews and approves what the extension asks to do.

settings.sync.folder.reason.missing.message: このフォルダーは存在しません。
settings.sync.folder.reason.missing.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: why the picked folder can't be used.

settings.sync.folder.reason.not_a_folder.message: これはフォルダーではなくファイルです。
settings.sync.folder.reason.not_a_folder.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the picked path, or the “Kage Sync” inside it, is a file.

settings.sync.folder.reason.drive_root.message: ドライブの最上位ではなく、フォルダーを選択してください。
settings.sync.folder.reason.drive_root.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the user picked a drive root such as C:\ or /.

settings.sync.folder.reason.kage_folder.message: これは Kage 自身のフォルダーです。同期アプリが同期しているフォルダーを選択してください。
settings.sync.folder.reason.kage_folder.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the folder is inside Kage's settings or data folders.

settings.sync.folder.reason.temp.message: これは一時フォルダーです。中のファイルはいつでも削除される可能性があります。
settings.sync.folder.reason.temp.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the folder is inside the system's temporary folder.

settings.sync.folder.reason.read_only.message: Kage はこのフォルダーにファイルを作成できません。
settings.sync.folder.reason.read_only.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the folder is read-only.

settings.sync.folder.reason.denied.message: Kage にはこのフォルダーを開く権限がありません。
settings.sync.folder.reason.denied.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the OS denied access to the folder.

settings.sync.folder.reason.unreadable.message: Kage はこのフォルダーを読み取れません。
settings.sync.folder.reason.unreadable.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: listing or reading the folder failed for another reason.

settings.sync.folder.reason.not_respondi.message: このフォルダーが応答しません。同期アプリが実行中であることを確認してから、もう一度お試しください。
settings.sync.folder.reason.not_respondi.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: reading the folder timed out (for example a stalled cloud drive).

settings.sync.folder.reason.inside_sync.message: このフォルダーは「Kage Sync」フォルダーの中にあります。「Kage Sync」を含むフォルダーを選択してください。
settings.sync.folder.reason.inside_sync.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the user picked a folder inside Kage's own sync folder structure. “Kage Sync” is the folder name and stays untranslated.

settings.sync.folder.reason.not_download.message: このフォルダーのダウンロードが完了していません。しばらくしてからもう一度お試しください。
settings.sync.folder.reason.not_download.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the sync folder's files are still placeholders in the cloud app.

settings.sync.folder.reason.incomplete.message: この「Kage Sync」フォルダーにはファイルが不足しています。同期アプリの処理が終わるまで待つか、別のフォルダーを選択してください。
settings.sync.folder.reason.incomplete.description: Sync setup, choosing a folder: the folder has computers' data but no kage-sync.json. “Kage Sync” is the folder name and stays untranslated.

errors.host_command.not_pending.message: このリクエストはすでに応答を待っていません。
errors.host_command.not_pending.description: Error when the user answers a prompt for a command an AI agent asked to run outside its sandbox, but the request already ended (answered, timed out or withdrawn).

errors.host_command.wrong_window.message: このリクエストは別のウィンドウに表示されています。そちらで応答してください。
errors.host_command.wrong_window.description: Error when the user answers a prompt for a command an AI agent asked to run outside its sandbox from a different Kage window than the one showing it.

errors.host_command.hidden_chars.message: このコマンドには非表示の文字が含まれているため、Kage では実行しません。代わりにコピーしてください。
errors.host_command.hidden_chars.description: Error: a command an AI agent asked to run outside its sandbox contains invisible characters (control, bidi or zero-width characters), so it can't be run from Kage.

errors.host_command.cannot_always.message: Kage はこのコマンドのルールを作成できません。代わりに 1 回だけ実行してください。
errors.host_command.cannot_always.description: Error: the user picked 'Always allow' for a command an AI agent asked to run outside its sandbox, but no rule can cover it (it may touch credentials, or isn't a simple command).

errors.host_command.bad_prefix.message: ルールにできません。; | & $ > などの記号や改行を含まない、通常の単語を使用してください。
errors.host_command.bad_prefix.description: Error: the words the user typed for an 'Always allow commands starting with …' rule aren't a simple command.

errors.host_command.prefix_mismatch.message: このコマンドはその単語で始まっていません。
errors.host_command.prefix_mismatch.description: Error: the user edited the words of an 'Always allow commands starting with …' rule so that the command being approved no longer starts with them.

errors.host_command.bad_decision.message: Kage はその応答を認識できませんでした。
errors.host_command.bad_decision.description: Internal error: the prompt for a command an AI agent asked to run outside its sandbox sent an unknown answer.

errors.host_command.too_many_rules.message: ルールの数が上限に達しています。設定 → ツールの権限 で一部を削除してください。
errors.host_command.too_many_rules.description: Error: the user tried to add another 'Always allow commands starting with …' rule but the list is full. Keep the Settings path as the app names it.

errors.host_command.allow_all_settings_o.message: この設定は設定画面でのみオンにできます。
errors.host_command.allow_all_settings_o.description: Error: the switch that lets every command an AI agent asks for run without asking can only be turned on from the Settings window.

host_commands.notify.title.message: {agent} がサンドボックスの外でコマンドを実行しようとしています
host_commands.notify.title.description: System notification title. {agent} is the name of the AI agent program (for example kiro-cli) that asked Kage to run a shell command outside the agent's own sandbox.

host_commands.notify.title_unknown.message: エージェントがサンドボックスの外でコマンドを実行しようとしています
host_commands.notify.title_unknown.description: System notification title when Kage doesn't know which AI agent asked it to run a shell command outside the agent's own sandbox.

host_commands.notify.body.message: Kage を開いて確認してください。承認しない限り何も実行されません。
host_commands.notify.body.description: System notification body for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox.

shared.host_command.title.message: {agent} がサンドボックスの外でコマンドを実行しようとしています
shared.host_command.title.description: Heading of the prompt shown when an AI agent asks Kage to run a shell command outside the agent's own sandbox (its sandbox refused the command). {agent} is the agent's name, for example Kiro.

shared.host_command.title_unknown.message: エージェントがサンドボックスの外でコマンドを実行しようとしています
shared.host_command.title_unknown.description: Heading of the prompt shown when an AI agent asks Kage to run a shell command outside the agent's own sandbox, when Kage doesn't know which agent asked.

shared.host_command.auto_title.message: {agent} がサンドボックスの外でコマンドを実行しています
shared.host_command.auto_title.description: Heading shown when Kage runs a command an AI agent asked for, outside the agent's sandbox, without asking (a rule the user made covers it). {agent} is the agent's name.

shared.host_command.auto_title_unknown.message: エージェントがサンドボックスの外でコマンドを実行しています
shared.host_command.auto_title_unknown.description: Heading shown when Kage runs a command an AI agent asked for, outside the agent's sandbox, without asking, when Kage doesn't know which agent asked.

shared.host_command.unmatched.message: このリクエストは Kage のチャットから送信されたものではないため、ルールは適用されません。
shared.host_command.unmatched.description: Note in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox: Kage couldn't tie the request to one of its own conversations (for example an agent running in a terminal).

shared.host_command.background.message: このリクエストは他のアプリのテキストを処理するバックグラウンドタスクから送信されたため、ルールは適用されません。
shared.host_command.background.description: Note in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox: the request came from a hidden background task (inline assist, a macro…) that works on text from other apps.

shared.host_command.reason_label.message: エージェントが示した理由:
shared.host_command.reason_label.description: Label in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox, before the agent's own explanation of why its sandbox can't run it. The explanation follows in the agent's words.

shared.host_command.run_once.description: Button in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox: run it this one time.

shared.host_command.always.message: 次の単語で始まるコマンドを常に許可
shared.host_command.always.description: Button in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox: run it, and from now on run commands that start with the words in the text field next to it without asking. The field follows the button.

shared.host_command.prefix_label.message: コマンドの先頭に必要な単語
shared.host_command.prefix_label.description: Accessible label of the editable text field next to the 'Always allow commands starting with' button: the first words of a command, for example 'brew install'.

shared.host_command.deny.description: Button in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox: don't run it.

shared.host_command.expires.message: {minutes, plural, other {# 分}}以内に応答がない場合、Kage は拒否します。
shared.host_command.expires.description: Line in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox. {minutes} is the time left before Kage denies the request on its own.

shared.host_command.guard.message: このコマンドは認証情報（{kinds}）にアクセスする可能性があります。このようなコマンドは、ルールの設定にかかわらず、Kage が実行前に必ず確認します。
shared.host_command.guard.description: Warning in the prompt for a command an AI agent asked Kage to run outside its sandbox. {kinds} is a comma-separated list such as 'AWS credentials, SSH keys'.
